message.content: {"answer": "B", "option_text": "Massive right pleural effusion", "reason": "The chest X-ray shows complete opacification of the right hemithorax with a contralateral (leftward) mediastinal shift. This combination indicates a space-occupying process pushing structures away, which is characteristic of a massive pleural effusion. Lung collapse (A) would cause an ipsilateral shift, and pneumothorax (F) would present with hyperlucency rather than opacity."}
